closureGoal: Determine whether the exact static stella-octangula catalog history is acceleration-balanced at its terminal full-delay-horizon endpoint without transferring evidence from a different release-source identity.

independentReference.kind: unchanged direct stationary pair sum plus closed-form radial coefficient
independentReference.pairRule: a_i = coupling * sum_{j != i} q_i q_j (x_i - x_j) / |x_i - x_j|^3
independentReference.scaleRule: radial coefficient relative to x scales as R^-3; acceleration magnitude scales as R^-2

decisionRule.instrumentPass: The source bytes and exact identity match the declaration; the source history is exactly [0,1]; every receiver has seven certified non-self roots within the retained history; the 56-root distance inventory matches the frozen multiplicities; the evaluated acceleration matches the unchanged independent pair sum and closed form; and every tangential residual is within tolerance.
decisionRule.scientificExclusion: If the instrument passes and every receiver acceleration magnitude exceeds the frozen balance tolerance, classify the exact prescribed static catalog history as excluded-prescribed-balance.
decisionRule.fail: Any source, identity, history, root-inventory, independent-reference, or symmetry mismatch fails the packet closed and licenses no adjudication.

claimBoundary.included: Derived and measured terminal-endpoint causal-root completeness and nonzero acceleration for the exact catalog identity and its exact stationary [0,1] history at T=1, c_f=1, coupling=1, and the declared isolated eight-member source inventory.
excluded: the distinct extended stationary release-source identity
